tools.name: list_listings
tools.description:
Get this shop's own listings, newest first, in every status unless you ask for one: active (on sale), sold or hidden.

Deleted listings never appear. A page holds 50 listings unless you set `limit` (at most 100); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it comes back null to read them all.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_listings, get_listing, create_listing, update_listing, list_webhooks, list_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: update_shop, create_listing, update_listing, bulk_create_listings, sync_catalogue, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook, contact_seller · Public sink: update_shop, create_listing, update_listing, bulk_create_listings, sync_catalogue, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook, contact_seller, send_message · Destructive: delete_listing, register_webhook, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_listings, get_listing, create_listing, update_listing, list_webhooks, list_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: update_shop, create_listing, update_listing, bulk_create_listings, sync_catalogue, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook, contact_seller · Public sink: update_shop, create_listing, update_listing, bulk_create_listings, sync_catalogue, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook, contact_seller, send_message · Destructive: delete_listing, register_webhook, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
